obligations.text: A Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock that both the merge base and the head hold, and whose two copies are equal once every workspace package's version is masked, is version-only; the guard counts it in neither policy nor other.
Any other change to a Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock keeps it policy: a registry dependency's version, a source, the lockfile format, an added or deleted file, or a path git quotes.
The guard's exits and its merge-base comparison are spec 044's; its summary line also counts the version-only paths.

sectionHeadings: 071: Setup profile revision 27: the policy-isolation guard ignores a workspace version bump
record.summary: Amends spec 044 section 3.3 and spec 002's setup profile. The policy-isolation guard classes any Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock as policy, so a release bump, which moves the workspace version in both beside its changelog and re-blessed fixtures, always reads as mixed and has needed an admin merge. Revision 27 adds a fourth class, version-only: a Cargo file present at both revisions that is unchanged once every workspace package's version is masked. Like generated paths it is ignored. A dependency, source, lockfile-format or new-file change keeps the file policy.
record.title: Setup profile revision 27: the policy-isolation guard ignores a workspace version bump
